profile.summary: 10+ yrs experience building software at businesses ranging from small ad agencies to large respectable software engineering-led companies with a expertise in all things JavaScript and burgeoning expertise and interest in ever higher levels of software architecture. I am seeking software engineering opportunities at established and reputable engineering-led companies.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served a role on the company's nascent Developer Platform (platform engineering) team as a lead with respect to all things JavaScript, including internal frameworks, libraries, and application templates.

Successfully liaised, collaborated, and planned with design, product, marketing, dev-ops, SRE, and the whole of the engineering organization to understand gaps in developer experience in order to provide and maintain tools, abstractions, and the guidance necessary to holistically and sustainably accelerate interdisciplinary needs in support of company goals.

Mentored several engineers both on and outside my immediate team. Contributed to tech talks, blog posts, and organization wide education on best practices and guidance via close collaboration with distinguished, architect, and principal engineering leads, which inarguably facilitated producing excellent output as well as acting as a great learning opportunity for me to level up my skillset.

Provided on-call support and pro-actively enhanced code across the engineering org via inner-source contributions.

Collaborated to facilitate project management skills where required.

Developed a repository to conduct pair-programmed Front-End client interviews.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as a lead Front-End/JavaScript role on a nascent FinTech team tasked with quickly and efficiently bootstrapping a business banking application stack.

Successfully created the first Micro Frontend (MFE) for the entire company for the client-facing banking application. Engineered the solution to be modular and abstracted so successfully that the pattern was adopted by the Developer Platform team (which I would eventually join) to be generalized within application templates to be used for all new React.js Front-End applications for all teams from that point forward. Presented a tech talk and corresponding blogpost on the learnings and potential enhancements for the MFE pattern with continued inner-source collaboration and contribution to the MFE tech stack that still powers all React.js Front-End applications at ZenBusiness to this day.

Effectively mentored and provided engineering oversight/management of 6+ off-shore software engineers in Vietnam to accelerate development of dozens of feature requests in record time without sacrificing code quality and maintainability. 

Contributed to and provided guidance for the banking related Node.js API codebase.

Inner-source contributed countless developer experience (devex) enhancements to repositories across the entire engineering org including streamlining and standardizing processess including: linting, formatting, testing, github workflows, automated dependabot (dependency) management, documentation generation, and much more.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on a team of 4 to support, maintain, and accelerate Vrbo + Expedia's Node.js platform. 

Our responsibilities include staying up to date with the Hapi.js and Node.js,ecosystems, dependency management via renovate automated dependency update tool, and the maintenance of our open source Expedia libraries. 

Additionally, we provide technical and feature support for hundreds of Vrbo and Expedia engineers.

positions.title: Senior UI Engineer
positions.description:
Working on a team of 4 engineers tasked with building, supporting, maintaining, and innovating the UI platform for the Vrbo engineering organization.

Team responsibilities include collaborating with UX/Design systems teams in building, supporting, and maintaining an extensive React.js UI component library leveraged by engineering teams across the Vrbo organization.

Additionally, we custom built an interactive component discovery portal to facilitate UI component discovery as well as provide a playground for developers to interact with UI components in real time.

Focus areas include UI component performance optimization, accessibility, and React.js industry best practices.

projects.title: 7 Election
projects.description:
Principal front end developer for the 2016 7 Election website. We partnered with The Onion to help drive traffic to the site. All Javascript logic is written in ES6 (ECMA 2016) and completely modularized leveraging Browserify to bundle and transpile the code for the browser.  Heavy utilization of the following design patterns: Promises, Observer, Module. 
Other tech I used: stylus, gulp, jQuery 3.0, Google Map API (heavily customized), ES6 Promise Debounce, Babel, Browser Sync, Event Emitter 2, and Notie.

projects.title: Umbrella.js Contributor
projects.description:
This was an opportunity I took to contribute some major functionality to a really great open source project. I worked collaboratively with library author to implement wrap and clone methods as well as fix append method. My Contributions are fully documented and tested using Mocha/Chai. I leveraged TDD (Test Driven Development). Asset and test management via Grunt.
https://github.com/umbrellajs/umbrella/graphs/contributors
